description: Image Description: The image depicts a modern bathroom vanity setup with a minimalist and clean design. The vanity features a light-colored stone countertop, likely quartz or marble, with a smooth, polished finish. Mounted on the countertop is a white, oval-shaped vessel sink with a sleek, contemporary design. A chrome faucet with a single lever handle is installed behind the sink, providing a modern touch. Below the countertop, there is a wooden cabinet with a rich, warm brown tone and horizontal grain patterns
